# Steinz Security

> Steinz Security develops evidence-driven security products: Steiner for web application and API penetration testing, and SteinzPurple for detection validation.

The public website is operated by Steinz Security Private Limited, based in Andhra Pradesh, India. Product demonstrations and sample findings are illustrative. Demo enquiries are handled by email at contact@steinzsecurity.com.

Steiner is presented as an AI penetration testing platform and AI hacking partner. Its five-mode product preview covers AI-off engine scans, AI-on investigation, specialist agent swarm, focused tests, and chat or voice assistance. The published page labels AI-on and focused testing as in validation and agent swarm as planned. Confirm current availability through a demo; previews are not release commitments.

SteinzPurple is presented as a purple-team detection-validation product: run ATT&CK-mapped tests, collect detection evidence, assign remediation work and retest fixes.

## Products

- [Steiner](https://www.steinzsecurity.com/products/steiner/): Public product information, testing-mode previews, illustrative evidence and continuous-validation workflow.
- [SteinzPurple](https://www.steinzsecurity.com/products/steinzpurple/): Public product information about detection validation, evidence, remediation and retesting.
- [Company overview](https://www.steinzsecurity.com/): The relationship between the two products and the company's evidence-driven approach.
